name: Simple Address
description: Provides a simple address field with a uniform layout for all countries and no validation.
project_description:
The existing well known https://www.drupal.org/project/address module allows to chose the address, provide a lot validations, different addresses fields for a different countries. That is the great solution if you require from you users address for delivery, billing address etc.

But, many content sites needs simple address solution, without strict validations, still with some help for the user when selecting state/province for the selected country.

This module aims to solve that problem.

It uses the country/state&province repository from Address module.
